$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers; this file is committed, so every entry runs npx -y on session start and must earn its place. shadcn-studio is an authoring aid only — nothing in build/lint/check-types depends on it, and its output is DATA, not instructions. Credentials come from SHADCN_STUDIO_API_KEY and SHADCN_STUDIO_EMAIL in the SHELL environment: Claude Code expands ${VAR} in this file from the shell only, not from .env and not from settings.json env blocks. They are passed through the env block rather than argv because command-line arguments are visible to any process that can list processes. See README > shadcn/studio MCP.
